result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but there is one clear defect: a raw localization key is displayed instead of a translated section title. A few minor cosmetic observations were also noted.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a localized string (e.g. 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation entry for 'home_feed.popular_title' to the locale files and ensure a fallback string is shown when a key is missing.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol...'), and the last category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the screen edge with no visible scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontal carousels, but consider adding a fade/gradient edge or partial-peek spacing to make it clearer that the lists scroll horizontally, and use ellipsis truncation on restaurant names.

issues.description: The 'See all' links use a light green color that may have borderline contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Verify the green meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) for text; darken slightly if needed.
